title: Izuku Midoriya: Origin
subtitle: Izuku Midoriya quiere desesperadamente ser un héroe, pero es uno de los pocos en su generación nacido sin una peculiaridad. ¿Conocer al héroe número uno, cambiará su destino?

title: What It Takes to Be a Hero
subtitle: Izuku accidentally learns of All Might's secret, but there's trouble in town again before Izuku has time to process it. Will All Might be able to save the day again?

title: Roaring Muscles
subtitle: All Might tells Izuku that he can become a hero, but does he really have what it takes to become one?

title: Start Line
subtitle: At the entrance exam, Izuku falls behind as the other students defeat faux villains left and right. Will he be able to get enough points to pass?

title: What I Can Do For Now
subtitle: It's Izuku's first day of high school, and he still can't control his new Quirk. Will he make it to the second day of school with his eccentric new teacher?

title: Rage, You Damn Nerd
subtitle: Izuku somehow gets through his first day of school and falls into a regular schedule of classes and training at U.A. In their first class with All Might...

title: Deku vs. Kacchan
subtitle: Izuku is up against Katsuki in their first class with All Might! Can he and Uraraka beat the villain team of Katsuki and Tenya before time runs out?

title: Bakugo's Start Line
subtitle: After the combat training lesson, the students and All Might reflect on their matches as they think about their next steps.

title: Yeah, Just Do Your Best, Iida!
subtitle: Class 1-A has to elect a class representative, and everyone wants the job! How will they choose? And what lies in wait for them at the next class?

title: Encounter with the Unknown
subtitle: Villains have attacked USJ, and it's up to Class 1-A to stop them. What are the villains after? Will All Might be able to save the day again?

title: Game Over
subtitle: The students of Class 1-A are up against the League of Villains. Will they survive long enough for help to arrive?

title: All Might
subtitle: All Might has finally shown up, but will he be able to defeat Nomu and save the day?!

title: Upon Each of Their Hearts
subtitle: As the battle at USJ winds down, Izuku and All Might think about its repercussions. Meanwhile, the villains slink home to plan their next move.

title: Hero Notebook
subtitle: Izuku looks back at the events that brought him to U.A. High School and on his path to becoming a hero.

title: That's the Idea, Ochaco
subtitle: As the students and teachers recover from the attack on USJ, Izuku learns why Ochaco wants to become a hero.

title: Roaring Sports Festival
subtitle: The U.A. sports festival begins and all eyes are on the first years as they start their qualifying round-the obstacle course race.

title: In Their Own Quirky Ways
subtitle: The first years try to stand out as they struggle to finish the obstacle course and qualify for a spot in the next round.

title: Strategy, Strategy, Strategy
subtitle: Izuku's having trouble finding a team for the cavalry battle in the next round of the U.A. sports festival. Luckily, he has a plan.

title: Cavalry Battle Finale
subtitle: Fighting it out in the second half of the cavalry battle, does Team Midoriya have what it takes to stay in the top four?

title: The Boy Born with Everything
subtitle: Izuku learns more about Todoroki's past as the first-years head into the final round of the sports festival.

title: Victory or Defeat
subtitle: Izuku is up against Shinso in the first match of the finals, but can he overcome Shinso's Quirk to advance to the next round?

title: Battle On, Challengers!
subtitle: It's one match after another in the first round of the finals tournament. Who will advance to the second round?

title: Bakugo vs. Uraraka
subtitle: Bakugo seems almost villainous when he's up against Uraraka, but she has a plan to keep it from being a one-sided match.

title: Shoto Todoroki: Origin
subtitle: Izuku forces Todoroki to face his past and himself as they square off in the first match of the second round of the finals.

title: Fight on, Iida
subtitle: It's time to see who will make it to the final showdown. Will Iida's Reciproburst be enough to beat Todoroki?

title: Todoroki vs. Bakugo
subtitle: Todoroki and Bakugo, the two finalists, begin their fight with one another.

title: Time to Pick Some Names
subtitle: Following their epic debut at the sports festival, it's time for the first-years to pick the most important part of their identities-their hero name!

title: Bizarre! Gran Torino Appears
subtitle: The internships begin! While everyone adjusts to their new tasks, Izuku starts training with Gran Torino, the same man who once taught All Might.

title: Midoriya and Shigaraki
subtitle: The U.A. students are finally starting to get the hang of their internships, but Izuku has much more to learn about One For All.

title: Hero Killer: Stain vs U.A. Students
subtitle: Stain strikes again, and this time some U.A. students are around when it happens. Will they be able to hold him off until the pros come?

title: Climax
subtitle: It all comes to a head as Izuku, Iida, and Todoroki face off against Stain while the pro heroes in Hosu City fight against the Nomus.

title: The Aftermath of Hero Killer: Stain
subtitle: Stain is finally captured, but now the hero community must deal with the consequences of their actions.

title: Everyone's Internships
subtitle: As Izuku, Iida, and Todoroki recover from their fight with Stain, the other members of Class 1-A work hard at their own internships.

title: Listen Up!! A Tale from the Past
subtitle: The students return to their daily lives while All Might has a special history lesson for Izuku. It's time to learn about One For All!

title: Gear Up for Final Exams
subtitle: Finals are coming up, and Class 1-A is going to need more than a cram session. This year, the teachers are changing the practical exams.

title: Yaoyorozu: Rising
subtitle: The exams are turning out to be much more challenging than the students expected. Can any of the teams hold their own against a teacher?

title: Stripping the Varnish
subtitle: As the students of Class 1-A fight in their practical exams, their resolve to become heroes is put to the test.

title: Katsuki Bakugo: Origin
subtitle: Midoriya and Bakugo begin their match with All Might but the two of them have different plans.

title: Encounter
subtitle: The league of villains has two people wanting to join them. UA students go to the mall. When they're at the mall everyone goes off on their own leaving Midoriya by himself where he encounters Tomura Shigaraki.

title: Game Start
subtitle: A recap episode highlighting the first 2 seasons as Class-1A and Class-1B prepare to start summer camp.

title: Wild, Wild Pussycats
subtitle: The kids arrive at camp, where they will be subjected to hard work like they've never experienced before.

title: Kota
subtitle: Midoriya finds out more about Kota and why he feels so strongly about heroes as a small but competent group of villains threaten to endanger the lives of everyone in the camp.

title: My Hero
subtitle: The villains launch their attack, and only Izuku knows where Kota is. Can he get to him in time?

title: Drive It Home, Iron Fist!!!
subtitle: As the students and teachers retaliate against the villains, two students take it into their own hands to handle the unknown gas swirling across the forest.

title: Roaring Upheaval
subtitle: The students and teachers of U.A. are still fighting in the woods, but has the Vanguard Action Squad accomplished its mission already...?.

title: What a Twist!
subtitle: Todoroki, Kirishima, and Midoriya want to go after Bakugo, but the class rep is standing in their way. Meanwhile, Shigaraki makes Bakugo an offer...

title: From Iida to Midoriya
subtitle: Todoroki, Kirishima, and Midoriya want to go after Bakugo, but the class rep is standing in their way. Meanwhile, Shigaraki makes Bakugo an offer...

title: All for One
subtitle: The heroes and U.A. students close in on the League of Villains' hideouts, but the League still has an ace up its sleeve.

title: Symbol of Peace
subtitle: As the fight against the League of Villains escalates, can the U.A. students get Bakugo out in time for All Might to make a big comeback?

title: One For All
subtitle: All Might's time is running out as he faces his ultimate nemesis head on. Will he finally be able to defeat All For One once and for all?

title: End of the Beginning, Beginning of the End
subtitle: Students and faculty react to the fallout of All Might and All for One's confrontation.

title: Moving into Dorms
subtitle: The students of Class 1-A move into the dorms and have a competition to determine who has the best room as they settle in.

title: Create Those Ultimate Moves
subtitle: Class 1-A works on developing their Quirks and creating ultimate moves in order to get ready for the provisional hero licensing exam.

title: The Test
subtitle: Izuku and his classmates make some final adjustments to their ultimate moves and then head off to the provisional licensing exam.

title: Shiketsu High Lurking
subtitle: The provisional licensing exam has begun, and everyone's after Class 1-A. Can they last long enough to pass this first test?

title: Class 1-A
subtitle: Todoroki's on his own against Seijin High, and Yaoyorozu's group is pitted against Seiai Academy as they and the rest of Class 1-A fight to pass the first test.

title: RUSH!
subtitle: It's down to the final minutes of the first test of the provisional licensing exam and almost half of Class A is still left.

title: Rescue Exercises
subtitle: The second test of the provisional licensing exam has begun, and the hero candidates are suddenly thrust into a rescue operation.

title: Special Episode - Save the World with Love!
subtitle: We take a break from the provisional licensing exam to visit a class held before the summer training camp.

title: What's the Big Idea?
subtitle: The exam nears its end, but Izuku and the other hero candidates must fend off Gang Orca to finish the rescue mission.

title: A Talk about Your Quirk
subtitle: While the U.A. students finish up the provisional licensing exam and get their results, All Might has a talk with All For One.

title: Deku vs. Kacchan, Part 2
subtitle: Following the provisional licensing exam, Izuku tries out his Shoot Style on Bakugo as they have a heart-to-heart through their fight.

title: A Season for Encounters
subtitle: The world has changed for villains and heroes alike in the weeks after All Might's fight with All For One, and the U.A. students start their second semester.

title: Unrivaled
subtitle: The students of Class 1-A learn about work studies from the Big Three. Meanwhile, the villains also prepare their next steps.

title: The Scoop on U.A. Class 1-A
subtitle: After All Might announces his retirement, freelance reporter Taneo Tokuda goes to the dorms to investigate U.A. Class 1-A.

title: Overhaul
subtitle: Overhaul pays a visit to the League of Villains, and Midoriya tries to find a place to do his work study.

title: Boy Meets...
subtitle: Izuku battles Sir Nighteye so he can do his work study at Nighteye's agency, but Nighteye has someone else in mind to be All Might's successor.

title: Fighting Fate
subtitle: Izuku's mind is swirling with feelings from his work study, so he goes and talks to All Might about it and learns about All Might's fate.

title: Let's Go, Gutsy Red Riot
subtitle: Kirishima begins his work study with Fat Gum and Amajiki and runs into a criminal situation. Meanwhile, Shigaraki and Overhaul meet up in order to discuss an alliance.

title: An Unpleasant Talk
subtitle: The work study students from U.A. attend a meeting of heroes gathered by Sir Nighteye and leave with new resolve.

title: GO!!
subtitle: The work study students wait until the pro heroes find Eri and it's time to start the operation to save her.

title: Suneater of the Big Three
subtitle: The Shie Hassaikai is going all out to stop the heroes, and Suneater volunteers to take out the first batch of Eight Bullets members in their way.

title: Red Riot
subtitle: As the fight with the Shie Hassaikai continues, Kirishima has to face his past when he and Fat Gum get separated from the others.

title: Temp Squad
subtitle: The Hassaikai gets some help from the League of Villains as the heroes continue to make their way to Overhaul to rescue Eri.

title: Lemillion
subtitle: The League of Villains stay true to their name in their fight. Meanwhile, Togata catches up to Overhaul and Eri first.

title: Unforeseen Hope
subtitle: Izuku, Eraser Head, and Sir Nighteye finally reach the area where Overhaul and the others are and find Togata past his limit.

title: Infinite 100%
subtitle: As the fight with the Shie Hassaikai reaches its climax, Overhaul looks back on how it all started, and Izuku uses All For One at 100%.

title: Bright Future
subtitle: As the heroes deal with the aftermath of the fight with the Shie Hassaikai, the vehicle transporting Overhaul has an encounter with the League of Villains.

title: Smoldering Flames
subtitle: After the fight with the Shie Hassaikai, a new villain emerges, and the students who participated reflect on their own roles as future heroes.

title: Win Those Kids' Hearts
subtitle: Camie joins the provisional license training course and is added to the team working with the kids from Masegaki. Meanwhile, Endeavor has a serious talk with All Might.

title: Relief for License Trainees
subtitle: The trainees bond with the precocious Masegaki kids and life at U.A. goes back to normal as autumn approaches, but Aoyama has been acting strangely.

title: School Festival
subtitle: As the students of U.A prepare for their school festival, Deku and Togata visit Eri in the hospital. Meanwhile, a new villain named Gentle Criminal begins his reign of crime.

title: Prepping for the School Festival is the Funnest Part
subtitle: As the date of the school festival draws nearer, Deku and the rest of Class 1-A decide who is going to do what in order to put on the greatest school festival ever.

title: Golden Tips Imperial
subtitle: The day of the festival is at hand and Class 1-A is ready. As they relax on the night before, Gentle Criminal hatches his plan to infiltrate the festival, starting with a very special tea.

title: Deku vs. Gentle Criminal
subtitle: While getting something for the festival, Deku runs into Gentle Criminal. Learning that he plans to infiltrate the festival, Deku begins to fight the mysterious villain and his partner La Brava.

title: School Festival Start!
subtitle: Deku scrambles to stop Gentle Criminal from infiltrating U.A's school festival using his Shoot Style technique. As La Brava uses her Quirk to power up Gentle, his resolve hardens as he fights against Deku.

title: Let it Flow! School Festival!
subtitle: Izuku rushes back to the school festival after his encounter with Gentle Criminal and La Brava, but will he make it in time for his performance?

title: Japanese Hero Billboard Chart
subtitle: It's time for the next Japanese Hero Billboard Chart rankings to be announced, and this time, all the top ten heroes make an appearance.

title: His Start
subtitle: Endeavor and Hawks continue to battle the mysterious Nomu enemy that attacked them. As they scramble to stop the villain and save the people, the whole world watches what the new "Symbol of Peace" is capable of.

title: All Hands on Deck! Class 1-A
subtitle: The day after Endeavor's climatic battle, Izuku and his classmate take part in a combat training exercise.

title: Vestiges
subtitle: Hawks reveals where his morals lie and Endeavour begins his journey to mend his relationship with his family.

title: Clash! Class A vs. Class B!
subtitle: Class A and Class B are joined by a special guest as they battle it out during their joint combat training.

title: Make It Happen, Shinso!
subtitle: The Class A team tries to put Shinso and his new equipment to good use in the first match against Class B.

title: Operation New Improv Moves
subtitle: It's darkness versus darkness as Tokoyami and Kuroiro face off in the second match of the class battles.

title: Foresight
subtitle: Separated from her team, Yaoyorozu's leadership skills are put to the test in the second match of the class battles.

title: Match 3
subtitle: In the third match of the class battles, Honenuki leads the Class B team against a well-balanced Class A team.

title: Match 3 Conclusion
subtitle: It's still anybody's game as the third match continues with an endurance battle between Todoroki and Tetsutetsu.

title: Early Bird!
subtitle: Bakugo shows a different side of himself in the fourth team match as the class battles continue.

title: That Which Is Inherited
subtitle: Midoriya and Shinso face off for the first time since the sports festival in the last fight of the class battles.

title: Our Brawl
subtitle: It's an all-out brawl as the last two teams from Class A and Class B fight it out to the finish.

title: The New Power and All For One
subtitle: As the class battles conclude, Midoriya works with All Might and Bakugo on learning more about his new power.

title: Have a Merry Christmas!
subtitle: It's Christmas at U.A. and the Class 1-A students celebrate with a Christmas party.

title: Off to Endeavor's Agency!
subtitle: Hawks acts strange when he meets Endeavor and his work study students on their way to Endeavor Agency.

title: One Thing at a Time
subtitle: As the villains continue to move behind the scenes, Endeavor helps his work-study students with the next steps in their training.

title: Long Time No See, Selkie
subtitle: Ryukyu brings her work study students with her when Selkie asks her to team up with him.

title: The Hellish Todoroki Family
subtitle: Endeavor brings his work study students over for dinner at Fuyumi's request but faces awkward conversations at home.

title: The Unforgiven
subtitle: One of Endeavor's biggest fans shows up to settle some unfinished business, and he expects far more than an autograph.

title: More of a Hero Than Anyone
subtitle: When an unsettling discovery is made regarding Kurogiri, Aizawa and Present Mic are summoned to interrogate him.

title: My Villain Academia
subtitle: A series of surprise encounters helps give Shigaraki a new sense of direction for the League of Villains.

title: Revival Party
subtitle: The League of Villains waits for Gigantomachia to wake up as they clash with the Meta Liberation Army.

title: Sad Man's Parade
subtitle: As Twice tries to save Toga, he thinks back on his past and makes a realization that helps him overcome it.

title: Tenko Shimura: Origin
subtitle: As the battle between Shigaraki and Re-Destro rages on, Shigaraki begins to remember his past.

title: Tomura Shigaraki: Origin
subtitle: Shigaraki remembers his first encounter with All For One during the climax of his battle with Re-Destro.

title: The High, Deep Blue Sky
subtitle: Both sides prepare for the confrontation between the heroes and the Paranormal Liberation Front as Class 1-A finishes their first year of high school.

title: A Quiet Beginning
subtitle: Usando la información que Hawks reunió, los héroes y sus estudiantes de estudio de trabajo se preparan para un ataque al frente de liberación paranormal liderado por Shigaraki.

title: Mirko, the No. 5 Hero
subtitle: Mirko persigue a Garaki mientras el resto del Equipo Endeavor se ocupa de Nomus en el Hospital Jaku. Por su parte, el equipo Edge Shot ataca por sorpresa en Gunga Villa.

title: One's Justice
subtitle: Inside Gunga Villa, the Paranormal Liberation Front realizes that they are under attack, and Twice confronts Hawks about his betrayal.

title: Inheritance
subtitle: Dabi se enfrenta a Hawks tras la muerte de Twice, mientras tanto en el Hospital Endeavor, Eraser head, Crust, Present Mic y X-less llegan finalmente para ayudar a Mirko, que está arriesgando su vida para detener el despertar de Shigaraki.

title: The Thrill of Destruction
subtitle: After reinforcements finally arrive, the tide is just starting to turn in the heroes' favor when Shigaraki wakes up.

title: Encounter, Part 2
subtitle: Endeavor le dice a su equipo que está luchando contra Shigaraki, Midoriya se da cuenta de que Shigaraki va tras Uno Para Todos y se utiliza a sí mismo como cebo para intentar alejar a Shigaraki de los civiles.

title: Disaster Walker
subtitle: El equipo Endeavor se enfrenta a Shigaraki mientras Gigantomachia se abre paso entre los héroes que rodean Gunga Villa y se dirige hacia la retaguardia del Equipo Edge Shot.

title: League of Villains Vs. U.A. Students
subtitle: Liderados por Yaoyoruzu, los estudiantes en prácticas de las clases 1-A y 1-B de la U.A. se enfrentan a Gigantomachia, que se dirige hacia ellos con la Liga de Villanos a sus espaldas.

title: Katsuki Bakugo: Rising
subtitle: Aizawa parece estar fuera de combate, Midoriya intenta mantener a Shigaraki en el aire utilizando todas sus peculiaridades. Sabiendo que su límite está cerca, Bakugo idea un plan para ayudarle.

title: The Ones Within Us
subtitle: El ataque de Shigaraki atravesó a Kacchan. Deku se pierde en su rabia y se lanza contra Shigaraki. Sin embargo, las cosas cambian de repente. En el mundo de One For All, Deku se enfrenta a Shigaraki y a All For One.

title: Dabi's Dance
subtitle: Toga se enfrenta a Uraraka. Intentan comprender los motivos del otro. Mientras tanto, en Jaku, Gigantomachia llega hasta Shigaraki y espera sus órdenes. Dabi revela su verdadera identidad a Endeavor y Shouto.

title: Threads of Hope
subtitle: Best Jeanist aparece e hila las esperanzas de todos los héroes en esta lucha mientras se acerca el clímax de la guerra total.

title: Final Performance
subtitle: Thinking of his great-great-grandfather, Mr. Compress performs his greatest trick in order to save the League of Villains.

title: Hellish Hell
subtitle: La feroz batalla terminó con la huida de Shigaraki. Muchos héroes renunciaron a sus vidas, las ciudades fueron destruidas y la gente perdió sus hogares. La fe en los héroes, y el futuro y las sonrisas de todos empiezan a desaparecer.

title: Tartarus
subtitle: Under All For One's control, Shigaraki attacks Tartarus with the Nomus to free All For One's body, freeing many other prisoners in the process.

title: The Hellish Todoroki Family, Part 2
subtitle: Mientras los héroes se enfrentan a las críticas del público, Hawks recuerda su pasado con su familia y la familia de Endeavor lo visita en el hospital.

title: The Wrong Way to Put Out a Fire
subtitle: Endeavor y su familia reflexionan sobre el pasado de Toya y los acontecimientos que lo llevaron a la muerte, y Hawks y Best Jeanist les hacen una propuesta.

title: Izuku Midoriya and Tomura Shigaraki
subtitle: Izuku sigue durmiendo, es conducido al mundo de Uno Para Todos. Generaciones pasadas de portadores comparten secretos. Y entonces, se le pregunta: "¿Puedes matar a Tomura Shigaraki?

title: Full Power!!
subtitle: Muscular llega y casi mata a Yo Shindo, pero no antes de que Deku intervenga y ambos tengan una revancha. Antes de esto, All Might recuerda lo que había sucedido dentro del hospital cuando Deku acababa de despertar.

title: Hired Gun
subtitle: The top three heroes continue to face criticism as they deal with jailbreakers and look for hints about All For One and Shigaraki's whereabouts, and Izuku comes across a villain from Tartarus.

title: The Lovely Lady Nagant
subtitle: Durante la lucha de Izuku con Lady Nagant, ella le cuenta secretos sobre la sociedad de los héroes que consolidan aún más su decisión de ayudar a quienes lo necesitan.

title: Friend
subtitle: Izuku se va solo en su búsqueda de justicia, sus compañeros se dan cuenta de que algo va mal e intentan encontrar la forma de ayudarle.

title: Deku vs. Class A
subtitle: Deku intenta huir, pero la Clase A lo atrae hacia sí contándole sus recuerdos y recordándole sus propias palabras.

title: A Young Woman's Declaration
subtitle: Mientras los evacuados de U.A. expresan su desacuerdo, Ochaco habla para intentar convencerles. Los espectadores vinculados a Izuku intentan averiguar si ha llegado el momento de que ellos también se pronuncien.

title: No Man Is an Island
subtitle: Izuku intenta descansar y recuperarse de vuelta en U.A. con sus compañeros de clase, All Might tiene un encuentro con Stain que le lleva a obtener nueva información sobre Shigaraki y All For One.

title: OVA: Rescue! Rescue Training!
subtitle: Four weeks after the attack on class 1A's rescue practice, the students resumed training. This time, the teachers are injured. They are forced to face the villain all by themselves.

title: Make It! Do-or-Die Survival Training 1
subtitle: In preparation for Class 1-A's Provisional Hero License Exam, Eraser Head decides to give the class a training exercise on disaster rescue, due to previous license exams having a disaster rescue test in most cases.

title: Make It! Do-or-Die Survival Training 2
subtitle: Izuku looks up the elevator shaft and notices that sunlight is pouring in from the top. Momo notes that the elevators only lead to the inside of the first floor, leading Tsuyu to theorize the surface has collapsed.

title: OVA: HLB
subtitle: The "Hero League Baseball" is an organization set-up by several Pro Heroes to allow them the chance to play and compete in their spare time. For this year, the "Orcas", led by Gang Orca, and the "Lionels", led by Shishido, have made it to the finals. Present Mic narrates the game, accompanied by an extremely apathetic Eraser Head.

title: OVA: Laugh! As If You Are in Hell
subtitle: It's been ten months since Izuku en-rolled at U.A. High School, and on top of his regular school work, four days a week he has been continuing his Hero Work-Study at the Endeavor Agency. On one day, they are approached by a police officer, seeking assistance in tracking down a local graffiti artist vandalizing the streets.

title: U.A. Heroes Battle
subtitle: Third-year Mirio Togata greets the first-year students in Class A with the card game UA Heroes Battle, where each student picks cards and joins the fierce battle.
